'''Fush Regular BHBM''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 22 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM Fush DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A pretty standard BHBM I guess. Constructive feedback is welcome.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Nothing revolutionary here I think. But I could really use some feedback on this deck. Which cards should stay, which should be replaced and what do I miss?
